messages:
anya: Heads-up: Helix Health wants a custom POC pricing path. They want to run 2 POCs in parallel, claim credits for both, then roll up to one enterprise commit if converted within 60 days. Can we support stacking + short conversion window?
riya: We can support stacking only if both POCs bill to same billing account. If they use separate legal entities we treat separately.
dan: Deal Desk: short window (60d) is ok but we need SOW mapping and explicit commit cap. Recommend: cap total convertible credit to $50k and list per-POC maxima.
megan: Ops/Infra note: if they reuse the same endpoint names/projects we might see shared cache benefits — call that out in the quote so they don't get surprised.
revops-bot: For POC-crediting flow, RevOps needs CSV with columns: BILLING_ENTITY, POC_TAG, START_TS, END_TS, CREDIT_CAP, COMMIT_TARGET. Upload with /deal-request.
anya: Customer insists "no invoice during POC". Ops preference: we meter everything and apply credits post-period so we keep telemetry.
riya: Agreed. Meter+credit keeps SLO/billing data. Also include model-specific SKU rates in the SOW since they will run one POC on a large-model config and the other on a smaller quantized config.
dan: Draft SOW snippet to use in the deal-request:
```nBILLING_ENTITY=Helix-Global
POC_TAGS=HELIX-POC-A,HELIX-POC-B
POC_WINDOWS=2026-05-01 to 2026-05-31;2026-05-01 to 2026-06-15
POC_CREDITS=Apply 100% credit on metered usage up to $25,000 per POC
CONSOLIDATED_COMMIT=If converted within 60d apply up to $50,000/mo for 12 months
CREDIT_EXPIRATION=60d
STACKING_CAP=2 POCs per billing entity without special approval
MODEL_SKU_OVERRIDES=large-model:x2.0;quantized-model:x0.6
```
dan: Sending to Legal for sign-off on credit/refund language.
legal-bot: Legal: credits must be timeboxed and auditable; no cash refunds for committed fees; require usage logs and right to audit POC usage before applying credits.
megan: Noted. I'll prepare the traffic profiles and attach CSV to the /deal-request.
anya: Thanks — will queue the deal-request after I confirm billing entity with the customer.
